title: I spent 10 hours building this SEO workflow so you don't have to
description: I spent 10 hours building this SEO workflow so you don't have to. One URL in → ranked articles out. Fully automated. Claude Code does the research, finds what your competitors are missing, and Arvow generates and publishes the content straight to your site. You can even schedule it to run every morning at 9am while you sleep. This is the workflow behind a site doing $12K/month in traffic value. #claudecode #AISEO #SEO #contentmarketing #seo2026
